tei:div.tei:p: ༁ྃ: grub chen mi tra'i snying thig las: tshe sgrub ye shes snying po bzhugs: ༁ྃ: rang byung tshe dpag med la 'dud: de nyid sgrub pa'i thabs tshul gyis: 'chi med dngos grub thob 'dod na: zab mo'i rnal 'byor 'di ltar bsgom: tshogs bsags rim pa sngon song nas:

zhes gsungs pa ltar sgrub thabs tsam la skyabs sems yan lag bdun pa dang dbang sgrub lta bu la spro na sngon 'gro'i chos skyabs sems tshogs bsags bka' bsgo srung 'khor byin 'bebs mchod pa byin rlabs rnams spyi ltar ram tshe sgrub gang rung ltar bya'o/ mchan/ āḥ stong pa'i ngang las snying rje'i rtsal: a yig dkar po 'od 'bar las: rang nyid bcom ldan tshe dpag med: ston zla'i mdog can zhi zhing 'dzum: mnyam bzhag phyag rgyas tshe bum 'dzin: dar dang rin chen rgyan gyis brgyan: rdo rje'i skyil krung pad zlar bzhugs: 'od zer gzi brjid lham mer gsal: gnas gsum yi ge'i 'phro 'du yis: ye shes spyan drangs gnyis med bsam: oṃ a pa ri mi ta ā yur+dz+nyā na sa twa sa ma ya e h+ye hiḥdzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ na mo na mā miḥ sarba pū dza ho: hrīḥ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyi: so sor rtog pa'i ye shes sku: gdod ma'i mgon po snang mtha' yas: tshe dpag med la phyag 'tshal bstod: thugs kar zla steng a yig mthar: gzungs sngags phreng bas bskor ba las: 'od 'phros srid zhi'i tshe bcud bsdus: 'chi med rdo rje'i srog 'grub gyur: oṃ a pa ri mi ta ā yur+dz+nya na sarba sid+dhi hūm̐ hrīḥ mtshan brgya brgyad pa'i gzungs kyang bzlasaḥ zhes pa tshe gzungs yongs grags yin lags/ mchan/ bdun phrag gcig tu brtson pa yis: sdig sgrib byang zhing tshe 'phel 'gyur: gu h+yaḥ sa ma yaḥ slob ma rjes su 'dzin 'dod na: stegs bu'i dbus su me tog bkram: bum pa bcud ldan chas su gzhug: tshe rdzas ril bu bdud rtsi bsham: mchod pa'i phreng bas mdzes par bya: bdag mdun lhar gsal tshe bcud bsdu: bum lha 'od zhu bdud rtsir bsam: slob mas maṇ+ḍal sngon 'gro bas: ye shes chen po tshe yi bdag: ces pa nas tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: zhes pa'i bar dbang chog tu bris yod: shis brjod sngags kyis brtan par bya: de ltar snod ldan slob ma la:

dbang gi mchog 'di sus bskur ba: bar chad zhi zhing tshe bsod 'phel: mthar thug pad+ma can du skye: gu h+ya sa ma ya: ༈ tshe dang bsod nams dgug bya'i phyir: thugs dam bskul ba'i phrin las ni: spos bsreg rol mo snyan par 'khrol: mda' dar g.yab cing gdung dbyangs bcas: āḥ gdod ma'i mgon po bcom ldan 'das: tshe dang ye shes 'od dpag med: dri med zla ba rgyas pa'i sku: mtshan dang dpe byad dpal du 'bar: thugs rje'i gzi byin lham me ba: phyogs bcu dus bzhi'i rgyal ba yi: mkhyen brtse byin rlabs gcig bsdus pa: tshe yi bdag po dbyings nas bzhengs: ka dag gnyug ma'i ngang nyid las: lhun grub snang ba phyogs brgyar spros: rdo rje tshe yi pho nya mo: mgyogs ma nyi zer rdul ltar 'khrigs: phyi snod 'byung ba'i dwang ma dang : nang bcud skye 'gro'i tshe bsod stobs: gsang ba rgyal ba sras bcas kyi: thugs rje nus stobs yon tan dpal: bdag gi bla tshe chad nyams bcas: ye shes chen pos byin gyis sdus: bdag dang sgrub pa'i rdzas la bstim: tshe bcud nyams pa gong du gsos: gnas pa spel la yar ba sdus: 'chi med rdo rje'i dngos grub stsol: sgrub rdzas ye shes bdud rtsir skyil: phyi nang gsang ba'i bar chad sol: lus ngag yid la dbang bzhi skur: ngo mtshar rtags dang cho 'phrul ston: thams cad chos nyid gcig gi ngang : 'chi med mgon po'i sku gsung thugs: ye shes rdo rjer byin gyis rlobs: oṃ a pa ri mi ta ā yur+dz+nya na sarba sid+dhi hūm̐ hrīḥdz+nyā na ā yu ṣe hūm̐ bh+rūm̐ nṛ dzaḥ.ā we sha ya a āḥ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ tiṣ+ṭha bh+rūm̐: zhes bskul bzlas pa mang du bya: rten 'brel mda' yi bra la brtags: bri na tshe nyams sor gsum las: lhag na tshe yar rim gro bya: sor gcig nad med gnyis tshe ring : gsum lhag bsod nams ye shes rgyas: gu h+ya sa ma ya: phrin las kha bsgyur rim pa ni: dri bzang bud shing me sbar la:

lha bskyed durba'i sbyin sreg bya: oṃ badz+ra ā yu ṣe sarba sid+dhi swā hā: 'bum bzlas tshe nyams nges par 'phel: 'byung bzhi'i dkyil 'khor dbus gnas pa'i: sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar bh+rūm̐ḥ mtha' dang rwa bzhi sngags kyis bskor: tshe bsod brtan pa'i spel tshig sbyar: mu khyud dbyangs gsal rten snying bskor: dri dang tshe rdzas bdud rtsis byug: rab gnas drod dang ma bral bcang : tshe bsod brtan cing rgyas par 'gyur: cung zhi brag zhun 'bras bu gsum: rtsa ba lnga dang dbang po lag: rtag ngu phyi nang bdud rtsi bcas: ril bu lhar bskyed tshe bcud bsdu: dam tshig sems dpar ye shes pa: bstim pa'i tshul du bcud kyis len: tshe ring nad med bde chen 'phel: de ltar shin tu zab 'dril ba'i: gdams pa snying gi dum bu 'dis: ma 'ong bstan 'dzin skyes bu rnams: 'chi med phrin las mthar phyin shog: gu h+ya sa ma yaḥ dge'o// //
